name: Riffkit
tagline: Rebuild a short video that already performed into your own product video
description: Give one source — a TikTok link, an uploaded video, or an analyzed template — and it riffs that video's formula (hook, pacing, emotional beats) into a new video for your product, with optional digital character, product placement, and 9 output languages. Needs a Riffkit account; rendering consumes paid balance.
